skills.name_ja: シューティングスター

raw.desc_en: Ride the momentum to surge ahead and very slightly increase acceleration after passing another runner toward the front late-race.
raw.desc_ko: 레이스 종반에 전방에서 상대를 추월하면 기세를 몰아 앞으로 나가면서 추가로 가속력이 아주 조금 상승한다
raw.desc_tw: 在競賽後期若於隊列前方追過對手會順勢向前邁進加速力會些微上升
raw.endesc: If you're not in the back of the pack and overtake someone during the Final Leg or beyond, you will get a speed boost and your acceleration will slightly increase

gene_version.desc_en: After passing another runner toward the front late-race, slightly surge ahead, and very minimally increase acceleration.
gene_version.desc_ko: 레이스 종반에 전방에서 상대를 추월하면 약간 앞으로 나가면서 가속력이 매우 조금 상승한다
gene_version.desc_tw: 在競賽後期若於隊列前方追過對手會略微向前邁進加速力會微微上升

raw.jpdesc: レース終盤以降に追い抜いて中団以前につけると前に出続けて加速力をちょっと上げ続ける
raw.jpname: シューティングスター

raw.endesc: Your Speed stat is increased by 60 on clockwise tracks
raw.jpdesc: 右回りコースならスピードが上がる

raw.desc_en: Moderately increase performance on right-handed tracks.
raw.desc_tw: 變得稍微擅長順時針賽道
raw.endesc: Your Speed stat is increased by 40 on clockwise tracks
raw.jpdesc: 右回りコースならスピードが少し上がる

raw.desc_en: Moderately decrease performance on right-handed tracks.
raw.desc_tw: 變得稍微不擅長順時針賽道
raw.endesc: Your Speed stat is decreased by 40 on clockwise tracks
raw.jpdesc: 右回りコースならスピードが少し下がる

raw.desc_en: Increase proficiency in right-handed tracks, increasing Speed and Power.
raw.desc_ko: 시계(우회전) 방향 코스에 강해져서 스피드와 파워가 상승한다
raw.desc_tw: 變得擅長順時針賽道速度和力量上升
raw.endesc: Your Speed and Power stats are increased by 60 on clockwise tracks
raw.jpdesc: 右回りコースならスピードとパワーが上がる

skills.name_ja: 弧線のプロフェッサー

raw.desc_en: Increase velocity on a corner with skilled turning.
raw.desc_tw: 變得擅長彎道速度上升
raw.endesc: At a random point on a random corner, your speed will increase
raw.jpdesc: いずれかのコーナーのどこかで速度が上がる
raw.jpname: 弧線のプロフェッサー

raw.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity on a corner with skilled turning.
raw.desc_tw: 變得擅長彎道速度略微上升
raw.endesc: At a random point on a random corner, your speed will slightly increase
raw.jpdesc: いずれかのコーナーのどこかで速度がわずかに上がる

raw.desc_en: Moderately decrease velocity on a corner with clumsy turning.
raw.desc_tw: 變得不擅長彎道速度稍微下降
raw.endesc: At a random point on a random corner, your speed will slightly decrease
raw.jpdesc: いずれかのコーナーのどこかで速度が少し下がる

raw.desc_en: Slightly increase acceleration after activating many skills early-race.
raw.desc_ko: 레이스 초반에 스킬을 많이 발동하면 가속력이 약간 상승한다
raw.desc_tw: 在競賽初期若發動多個技能加速力會略微上升
raw.endesc: Slightly increase acceleration when many skills are activated during the Opening Leg
raw.jpdesc: レース序盤にスキルを3回発動すると加速力がわずかに上がる

raw.desc_en: Increase acceleration when many skills activate early-race.
raw.desc_ko: 레이스 초반에 스킬을 많이 발동하면 가속력이 상승한다
raw.desc_tw: 在競賽初期若發動多個技能加速力會上升
raw.endesc: If you've activated at least 3 skills during the Opening Leg, your acceleration will increase
raw.jpdesc: レース序盤にスキルを3回発動すると加速力が上がる
